title: Own parsed receipts within full and reduced loads
detail: Normal full native validation and its independent audit now each own a separate syntax scope. Full local recovery and authenticated reduced recovery own their respective scopes too. Census, installed authority epochs, stored replay and cold index consume the same captured syntax. Completion is after the old final guards/index ownership checks; finally always disposes. An audit or separate load never borrows another load’s scope. Exact retained-row comparison still precedes the native callback. No crypto, witness, coverage, authority, commit or canonical comparison was removed. Independent normalized AST review covers all four changed modules.
validation: Five new tests; original four before repair show three failures/one pass, including four decodes per full load versus one afterward. Reduced suffix control initially had an invalid synthetic allocation counter; corrected fixture then demonstrated two versus one decodes across an interior frontier. All attempts retained. Types,192focused cases across23files and18unchanged legacy cases pass; quality, format,17registry checks, inventory and10controls pass. The latest full checkpoint remains410:321files/3152cases/one skip123.80s; it is not rerun for this bounded slice. Four source hashes/ten source-site line moves are reviewed, no construction/obligation/test removals.
summary: Actual full/native/reduced callbacks now own per-load syntax; five controls and192focused/18legacy cases pass. Existing operations and guards are AST-exact after explicit scope normalization.
limitations: No actual browser cold, image, activation, latency or RAM credit. Native continuation and live pages/dense writer, dual audit, G8/B and lifecycle/old artifacts/cold/rollback remain. No format/trust/wire/default/limit/gate/deadline change, commit or deployment.
decisionTitle: Keep independent load and audit syntax lifetimes
decision: Create and dispose syntax inside each verified load callback, complete only the final plain verified result, and keep audits/reference loads independent. Epoch scalar reuse and cold indexing preserve exact-byte/floor checks and actual proof-byte bounds.
next: Wire new-row-only scopes into native and reduced-owner continuations, preserving exact prefix checks and full fallback. Then live owned pages/dense writer, dual audit, G8/B and lifecycle/rollback. Continue automatically after each freeze; stop only for the operator decision or an unfixable guard-preserving failure.
